findings.title: Missing required argument in call to extend_due_date
findings.body: The call to `extend_due_date` on line 15 passes only `loan_id`, but the function now requires a `days` parameter. This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime. Pass the number of days to extend the loan by.

findings.title: Docstring is redundant with function body
findings.body: The docstring on line 5 repeats what the function body already expresses: it trims and capitalises the title. Remove the docstring to keep the code concise.

summary.problem: The change to `extend_due_date` breaks the caller in `renewals.py` and leaves a redundant docstring in `catalog.py`.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation were updated to accept a `days` parameter, improving flexibility.
